description: A PHP source file that manages the Wi-Fi settings page in a web-based router configuration wizard. It includes logic for displaying and updating Wi-Fi network names, security modes, passwords for both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, and handles user interactions and validation for configuration updates.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the updated Wi-Fi configuration to the server via an AJAX POST request.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Gathers form data, encodes it into a JSON object, and invokes set_config to save the configuration.
